fix_summary: parse_ship_date claims to parse a carrier timestamp but only accepts a plain date format ("%Y-%m-%d"). When carriers send full timestamps, strptime raises ValueError due to unconverted data. Update it to handle ISO 8601 timestamps (and date-only) e.g., using datetime.fromisoformat(raw.replace('Z', '+00:00')) or by trying formats including "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z" and falling back to date-only.
suggested_test: Add tests for parse_ship_date: assert parse_ship_date('2024-05-10') == datetime(2024, 5, 10); assert parse_ship_date('2024-05-10T14:23:55Z') == datetime(2024, 5, 10, 14, 23, 55, tzinfo=timezone.utc) or equivalent naive time if tz handling is standardized in code.
